text_block_list.text:
I hand a newly-delivered fan letter to
Mejiro
McQueen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I have read the letter. Thank you very
much.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
The expectations of people are quite
sobering,
aren't they?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
"The support from your fans is a
guidepost to
your dreams."
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Grandmother once said those words to
me. I feel
as though I've gotten a little
closer to
understanding their true
meaning.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list:
The person who wrote the letter would be
happy to hear that too, I'm sure.

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Then, I shall have to repay this
sentiment
with a good performance.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I will train to the best of my abilities
today and
always!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин happily puts in her
best effort
throughout the entire training
session.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
